sources.title: OneScience-Group/PXDesign · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The complete PXDesign workflow consists of the PXDesign diffusion generation model, ProteinMPNN sequence design, AF2-IG evaluation, and Protenix evaluation. The official implementation provides three primary modes, generation-only, preview, and extended, covering use cases from quick validation to complete candidate screening.
